Dear Jamie Patel,

Welcome to Lakeshore Logistics! We are happy to offer you the position of Data Analyst in our Operations Analytics group.

Your salary will be $6,250 per month, paid on the last business day of each month.

You will be eligible for an annual incentive bonus with a target of 5% of base salary.

This is an onsite role based in our Chicago, IL headquarters.

You will receive 15 days of paid vacation per year, along with medical and dental coverage and a 401(k) plan.

Your first day will be February 1, 2027.

Sincerely,

Robin Alvarez, Head of People, Lakeshore Logistics

This is a fictional sample letter created for testing. Names, companies and figures are made up.
